_comment: Canonical identity of the target ROM. This file is the single source of
truth for every identity check in this repository. tools/buusfury/identity.py
fails closed on ANY mismatch - wrong revision, wrong region, a single
flipped byte - and never continues with an unverified input.
File offset 0x00A0..0x00BC. Verified independently of the hash so that a
ROM with a correct-looking hash but a tampered header is still rejected,
and so that a wrong-revision dump is diagnosed rather than merely refused.
gba_header.title: DBZBUUSFURY

aliases._comment: The LOG1-REMAKE / Dragonbyte Z repository identifies the SAME image by CRC-32 rather than SHA-1. One ROM, two naming conventions - NOT two revisions.

known_distinct_images._comment: A separate Buu's Fury static-recompilation image. Byte-wise a DIFFERENT profile: its file offsets are not transferable without independent validation. Recorded so it can never be mistaken for the canonical baserom.
